name: 如庵
checkpoints: Small one-storey earthen-walled teahouse; kokera wood-shingle hip-and-gable roof with gable facing front, recessed earthen porch on the left.
Round bamboo lattice window on left wall, broad horizontal lattice window under low front eave, narrow right-hand opening; natural rough timber columns.
Draw only the small tea house on the RIGHT of the overview photo, omit trees, garden, signs, fences and the adjoining large Shoin hall.
